title: coryphantha wissmannii
intro: Coryphantha wissmannii, commonly known as the Wissmann's Pincushion Cactus, is a species of cactus in the genus Coryphantha. This plant is known for its round, fleshy stems and vibrant green or yellowish spines, which grow in a dense, pincushion-like pattern. Coryphantha wissmannii has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever reduction and anti-inflammatory properties due to its therapeutic actions, which include analgesia and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Coryphantha wissmannii include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
